answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a jetty that rotates unpredictably. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the relic of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Scaling the wharf therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1unef.
